_howToEdit: This one file holds everything on the website: shop info, branches, phones, socials, the deal and the menu. Change text between the quotes, save, and redeploy. Prices: replace "Rs. —" with e.g. "Rs. 150". Photos: put a file in /public/img/ and set "image": "/img/your-photo.webp" on an item.
